protocol.calibration_gate: At 90% intervals, coverage within three binomial standard errors of 0.9 and PIT KS <=1.63/sqrt(N), for learned and known-boundary models, both designs; prior-predictive scalar checks only
protocol.scope: Quasistatic one-plane bending; known reference geometry, cameras and correspondences; Gaussian-rendered illustrations, inference from noisy 2D center tracks. Material fixed, no trained encoder or flow-matching model.
protocol.stress_protocol: Three 400-case arms: off-grid boundaries only; shorter true force correlation length 0.8s only; both. Same force scale and material; no refitting. Separate arms added after initial combined stress failure.

limitations: Known material, reference geometry, camera poses, masks and point correspondences.
One-plane quasistatic Euler-Bernoulli bending; no inertia, contact switching, friction or 3D occlusion inference.
Support is a Gaussian distributed elastic foundation; no hard-clamp discovery.
Exact inference on a finite boundary dictionary; continuous/off-grid robustness checked separately.
Pointwise prior-predictive coverage is not simultaneous trajectory coverage or universal real-data calibration.
No encoder or conditional flow-matching model has been trained; this is its proposed reference benchmark.
